catalogue.name: split
catalogue.doc: Split text on `sep` and take part number `index` (0-based, negative allowed; "" if absent).

catalogue.name: join
catalogue.doc: Join all source values with `sep`, skipping missing and empty ones (None if all are).

catalogue.name: slice
catalogue.doc: Take characters (or list items) from `start` up to but not including `end`.

catalogue.name: char_at
catalogue.doc: Take the single character at `index` (0-based, negative allowed; "" if out of range).

catalogue.name: title
catalogue.doc: Convert text to Title Case (each word and hyphenated part capitalized).

catalogue.name: date_format
catalogue.doc: Format an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) with a strftime pattern, e.g. "%m/%d/%Y".

catalogue.name: date_part
catalogue.doc: Take month, day, year (4 digits) or year2 (2 digits) of an ISO date, zero-padded to `pad`.

catalogue.name: number_format
catalogue.doc: Format a number with fixed `decimals` (rounded half up), a thousands separator and a prefix.

catalogue.name: bool_to_check
catalogue.doc: True to tick a checkbox for a truthy value; false, no, 0, empty and missing leave it unticked.

catalogue.name: equals
catalogue.doc: True when the input equals `value` exactly (for ticking a checkbox on a matching option).

catalogue.name: contains
catalogue.doc: True when `value` is an item of the input list or a substring of the input text.

catalogue.name: default
catalogue.doc: Use `value` when the input is missing or an empty string.

catalogue.name: prefix
catalogue.doc: Put fixed text before the input (blank input stays blank).

catalogue.name: suffix
catalogue.doc: Put fixed text after the input (blank input stays blank).
